test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
E, F, G, H, I and J are sitting around a circular table facing the center. J sits immediate left of I. G sits second to the right of I. E sits second to the right of G. H sits second to the left of F.

Who sits third to the right of E?
solution: **Given :** E, F, G, H, I and J are sitting around a circular table facing the center. **Explanation :** 1) J sits immediate left of I. 2) G sits second to the right of I.
